acip: DE'I TSUL YANG RTOGS LDAN PA'I MNYAL LAM DU RJE'I MCHOD RTEN YIN ZER BA'I DKAR YOL GYI MDOG LTA BU PHYAG TSAD SHIN TU RDZOGS PA NOR BU RIN PO CHE'I TOG CAN RTZE SPRIN GSEB MTHON POR SLEBS PA LA MKHA' 'GRO MA MANG PO RIN PO CHE'I DBU RGYAN CAN RNAMS KYIS RIN PO CHE'I BUM PA BDUD RTZI DKAR POS GANG BA DPAG MED KYIS KHRUS GSOL BA DANG,
english: The way in which Tokdenpa obtains this clarification is that he has a dream, in which someone comes to him and says, "This is the Lord's offering shrine."  He sees a shrine of pure white, like porcelain, laid out in perfect lines.  At the very top of it is a point, made of a precious jewel, which stretches high into the midst of the clouds.  Here there are a great many divine Maidens, Angels of the sky, wearing headdresses of priceless gems, holding as well a countless number of precious vases filled with pure white nectar.  With the nectar then they make the gift of bathing.
